subject: Geopolitics
title: Covert Influence Campaigns
description: A short lesson to help you apply Covert Influence Campaigns.

hook.text: The CIA overthrew Iran's government in 1953 partly through fake newspaper stories and paid protesters.

buildup.text: Covert influence hides the sponsor's hand.

discovery.text: Modern covert campaigns use social media bots, fake accounts, and fabricated websites.

twist.text: When exposed, covert campaigns backfire spectacularly.

climax.text: Covert influence is powerful when hidden and devastating when revealed. The risk of exposure is the ultimate deterrent.

punchline.text: The best influence is invisible. The worst is caught.

quiz.question: What happens when covert influence campaigns are exposed?
options: They become more effective through publicity
The credibility damage often exceeds any gains
Target audiences become more sympathetic to the sponsor
